title: Fibresolve machine learning classifies IPF on non-definite UIP CT patterns
summary: Fibresolve was applied to HRCT scans from 51 patients with a non-definite UIP pattern, drawn from 193 patients in two prospective phase 2 trials. Sensitivity for IPF was 76.5% (95% CI 66.5-83.7), and 74.5% (60.5-84.7) in the 47 patients who needed surgical biopsy. The analysis is retrospective with a small sample, and specificity is not given in the abstract.
ai_technology: Fibresolve machine-learning classifier applied to HRCT chest imaging

evidence.tested: Sensitivity for the final IPF diagnosis was calculated against the diagnosis obtained, with surgical biopsy for 47 patients.
evidence.unknown: Specificity, performance outside this trial population and clinical impact are not reported. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: The Fibresolve machine-learning system classified IPF non-invasively from pre-biopsy HRCT images.
